Description: Infection from ingestion of contaminated water at rate a·λ(B), where λ(B) depends on bacterial concentration in water.
Recovery from cholera at rate r, returning individuals to the susceptible class because immunity is not lifelong.
Contribution of infected people to the aquatic bacterial population through excretion at rate e.
Local bacterial growth in the aquatic environment at rate nb.

Name: H
Description: Total human population size; assumed constant.

Name: n
Description: Renewal rate of susceptibles through birth, immigration, and/or loss of acquired immunity.

Name: a
Value: rate of exposure to contaminated water

Name: K
Value: concentration of Vibrio cholerae in water that yields 50% chance of catching cholera

Name: r
Value: rate at which people recover from cholera

Name: nb
Value: growth rate of Vibrio cholerae in the aquatic environment

Name: mb
Value: loss rate of Vibrio cholerae in the aquatic environment

Name: e
Description: Average per-capita bacterial input from infected individuals.
Value: contribution of each infected person to the population of Vibrio cholerae in the aquatic environment
